# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Independent swap header reader for a block device: version, last_page,
# nr_badpages, UUID, label, signature, and a digest of the whole device.
import hashlib, struct, sys, uuid
data = open(sys.argv[1], 'rb').read()
page = 4096
version, last_page, bad = struct.unpack_from('<III', data, 1024)
print('  version=%d last_page=%d nr_badpages=%d uuid=%s label=%r sig=%r bootbits_zero=%s sha=%s' % (
    version, last_page, bad, uuid.UUID(bytes=data[1036:1052]), data[1052:1068].rstrip(b'\0').decode(errors='replace'),
    data[page - 10:page], data[:1024] == bytes(1024), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:16]))
